note: For any real n x n orthogonal A with no fixed vector, complex eigenvalues have modulus 1; nonreal ones pair with conjugates and contribute product 1; the only real eigenvalue allowed is -1. If its multiplicity is r, n-r is even and det A=(-1)^r=(-1)^n. H fixes u-perp and sends u to -u, so det H=-1. Thus det(HQ)=(-1)^(n+1), whereas absence of a fixed vector for HQ would force (-1)^n, contradiction.
